title: Pandemic Impact Timeline
subject: Economics
topic: Timeline of Covid-19 pandemic and consumer confidence
caption: Timeline of key pandemic events and shifts in consumer confidence.
altText: A timeline diagram titled 'Pandemic Impact Timeline' showing eight chronological milestones: March 15 2020 lockdown begins, May 1 2020 lockdown eased, June 15 2020 national consumer confidence survey Q1, July 20 2020 vaccine trial phase‑III announced, December 1 2020 vaccine emergency use authorization, January 15 2021 consumer confidence index drops 12 points, April 1 2021 confidence begins gradual recovery, and September 30 2021 confidence surpasses pre‑pandemic level.
